query:
SELECT MAX(rs.updated_at) as "max_updated_at"
        FROM release_states rs
        JOIN destinations d ON rs.destination_id = d.id
        WHERE rs.project_id = $1
          AND ($2::uuid IS NULL OR rs.artifact_id = $2)
          AND d.environment = $3
          AND rs.mode = 'deploy'
          AND rs.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
